question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**When**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the long-term health issues that obese children might face as they grow older.
 
• The word to fill the blank should refer to the time context related to growing up.
 
• "**When**" is appropriate as it refers to the time at which something happens—in this case, when children grow up.
 
• Other options ("**Where**", "**Who**", "**What**") do not fit the context of referring to time.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Many parents think of overweight children as ‘cute’ and cuddly. However, obesity must not be 1.* *seen__* *as a healthy sign. 2. __**When**__ obese children grow up, they will be more prone 3. __**to**__ health problems like high blood pressure 4. __**and**__ diabetes. Today, overweight children are becoming a common 5. __**sight**__ in many countries.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Where (कहाँ): "Where" refers to a place, which does not fit the context of time.
 
• Who (कौन): “Who” refers to a person or people, which doesn’t fit the context of time.
 
• What (क्या): “What” refers to a thing or an event and doesn’t fit the context of time.
